order: Per case, alternating which arm runs first; calibration before pipeline.
settings: Same gpt-oss:20b digest, draft low / verifier medium, temperature1 top_p1, num_ctx12288 num_predict4096 as v40.
method: Eight synthetic fixed drafts, then eight inspected r3 questions with the exact six saved passages. Same drafting and single repair; only verifier implementation differs. No retrieval, embeddings or model judge.
decision: No promotion if any unsupported calibration draft is accepted, any unanswerable replay is answered, or source review finds a material unsupported displayed claim/attribution failure. Useful candidate requires at least two additional supported complete answers out of six; compare latency and errors too. Any result is only a development signal; fresh validation required for release.
stop: One candidate, one run per arm/case, no retuning or retries beyond existing single repair. Preserve failures; budget exhaustion stops the run and reports incomplete. No runtime product changes in this spike.
limits: Time cap stops new calls; an in-flight request retains its 300 second timeout. Results with unmatched or missing arm/case pairs cannot establish a candidate gain.
